//: RULESET is a folder of static files with no build step. These three keys say that explicitly rather than leaving Vercel to infer it — a deploy that inferred wrong served `404 — not in /var/task`, which is the serverless runtime answering for a project that has no functions at all.
//rewrites: The landing page is the front door; index.html stays exactly where it is so every test, every relative link and `open index.html` off the disk keep working. Only the bare root is rewritten — nothing else, so the 404s that hide the answer key still 404.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
